## Flagship Project: Ting AI
Ting AI is an AI-powered financial/market decision-support system.
- **Goal**: Help retail investors understand portfolio concentration, market risk, and macro context.
- **Role**: Created the full-stack system, AI reasoning architecture, and UI.
- **Tech Stack**: React, FastAPI, Python, Redis, Gemini API, Recharts, PM2, IIS.
- **Features**: Morning Command Center, Portfolio Risk Simulator, AI-driven chat helper (Ting AI Agent).
